correctness.rationale: All graph edges are reconstructed from the 20-vertex GP(10,2) specification. Independent Python bitmask enumeration of all 2^20 subsets and separate C++ inclusion/exclusion independent-set recursion agree on the complete odd-independent class histogram (1,20,100,120,90,0,10). All 15 pairs of disjoint eligible six-sets have no eligible four-set in their eight-vertex complement, eliminating four-color partitions; three colors cover at most 18 vertices. Explicit five-class witness satisfies all local tests. Two exact-cover recursions independently enumerate 212 five-color partitions with profile sizes 60/100/52 and precisely two square-color partitions. Each finite search enumerates a mathematically defined finite domain with no timeouts or sample approximations.

value.rationale: The dodecahedral graph is a natural classical cubic planar girth-five graph and double cover of the Petersen graph. The exhaustive 212-optimum partition census and exact odd-independent-set polynomial give a complete, motivated finite invariant; only two of the 212 optimum partitions are square colorings despite equality of the scalar minima, a meaningful structural boundary between local parity and distance-two constraints. This is more informative than a normalization check or routine substitution and supplies a finite benchmark for related graph-cover questions.
